teach.text: **أَنَا** (ana) means “I.” **أَنْتَ** (anta) means “you” when speaking to one male. **أَنْتِ** (anti) means “you” when speaking to one female.
**هُوَ** (huwa) means “he,” and **هِيَ** (hiya) means “she.” These forms refer to one person.

**اِسْمِي** (ismii) means “my name.” For example, **اِسْمِي سَارَة** (ismii saara) means “My name is Sarah.” Names are written here without their final case vowel, as people normally say them when speaking.
Ask a male **مَا اسْمُكَ؟** (maa smuka?), “What is your name?” Ask a female **مَا اسْمُكِ؟** (maa smuki?). The first vowel of اِسْمُكَ is dropped after مَا, so you say maa smuka, not maa ismuka.
**أَنَا طَالِبٌ** (ana Taalib) means “I am a male student.” **أَنَا طَالِبَةٌ** (ana Taaliba) means “I am a female student.”

practice.prompt: أَنْتَ is “you” when speaking to one male.
practice.explain: أَنْتَ is the form of “you” used when speaking to one male.

practice.prompt: Write the Latin pronunciation of اِسْمِي.
practice.explain: اِسْمِي means “my name” and is pronounced ismii.

practice.prompt: Match each Arabic word to its meaning.
practice.explain: أَنَا means “I,” هُوَ means “he,” and أَنْتِ is “you” addressed to one female.

quiz.prompt: You are speaking to one female. Which question asks her name?
quiz.explain: مَا اسْمُكِ؟ is the question for one female. مَا اسْمُكَ؟ is for one male.

quiz.prompt: Write the Latin pronunciation of the Arabic word for “I.”
quiz.explain: أَنَا means “I” and is pronounced ana.

quiz.prompt: Which phrase means “I am a female student”?
quiz.explain: أَنَا طَالِبَةٌ means “I am a female student.”

quiz.prompt: Match each Arabic phrase to its meaning.
pairs: What is your name? To one male
What is your name? To one female
quiz.explain: The final form differs: مَا اسْمُكَ؟ is for a male, and مَا اسْمُكِ؟ is for a female. اِسْمِي means “my name.”

quiz.prompt: أَنْتِ is used when speaking to one male.
quiz.explain: أَنْتِ is “you” when speaking to one female. أَنْتَ is for one male.

quiz.prompt: Write the Latin pronunciation of مَا اسْمُكَ؟, asked to one male.
quiz.explain: مَا اسْمُكَ؟ is asked to one male and is pronounced maa smuka?
